summary: Completed comprehensive testing of CryptoNexus platform. Core authentication and UI functionality working well. CoinGecko API rate limiting affecting market data and trading features.

critical_bugs.issue: Returns 404 due to CoinGecko API rate limiting (429 errors)
critical_bugs.impact: Blocks individual coin detail pages and trading functionality

critical_bugs.issue: Returns 400 'Could not fetch crypto price' due to CoinGecko API rate limiting
critical_bugs.impact: Prevents users from buying crypto via Stripe

api_rate_limiting.issue: Free tier rate limit exceeded (429 errors)
api_rate_limiting.workaround: Implement caching or upgrade to paid CoinGecko plan

authentication_issues.issue: JWT tokens don't persist across page reloads
authentication_issues.impact: Users get logged out when refreshing page or navigating directly to URLs

integration_issues.issue: Empty market data due to backend API rate limiting

passed_tests: User signup with email, password, and full name
Dashboard displays portfolio overview with $10,000 default balance
Dashboard shows portfolio cards (Total Balance, USD Balance, Crypto Holdings)
Dashboard displays portfolio chart and recent transactions section
Markets page loads with search functionality
Wallet page displays holdings and transaction history sections
Navigation between Dashboard, Markets, and Wallet pages
Logout functionality redirects to auth page
Authentication API endpoints (signup, login, get user)
Portfolio API endpoint returns correct structure
Transactions API endpoint returns empty array for new users
Sell crypto API correctly validates insufficient balance
UI design matches dark theme guidelines
Toast notifications work for success/error messages

high_priority: Fix CoinGecko API rate limiting by implementing caching or upgrading to paid plan
Implement JWT token persistence in localStorage/sessionStorage for better user experience
medium_priority: Add error handling for API failures in frontend components
Consider adding mock data fallback when CoinGecko API is unavailable
low_priority: Add loading states for better UX during API calls
